The '''parliament of Illodia''' was the governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Illodia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, a number of Imperial-friendly politicians acquired seats in the parliament after an election.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Using the System}}</ref>
